notes: Narrow pale-teal painted Victorian flat front: two three-sided bays on the upper storeys, steel fire escape between them, bracketed cornice; ground: small shop window, recessed doors, display window. The mint Victorian stands on the lot to the SW, which has no DataSF footprint; this 6.3 m footprint (roll: built 2001, residential, 5 storeys, LiDAR 14.9 m) is the narrow dark modern infill between the Victorian and the low wood-clad building: charcoal two-storey base with a tall recessed dark entry, mid-grey rendered upper storeys with a single wide window per storey, flat roof with a deck rail. Smooth render weathering (no streak columns) and reflective glass (glassModel). No streak weathering. Soot at the base, grime, faint wide streaks. Pale concrete modern building above a dark recessed ground floor; the stucco base x warm plaster read brown-tan, so painted-white in a light grey.
